description: Unchanged original diagnostic HTTP listener-cleanup and response-cap tests, with both Node transports mocked.
isolationRationale: Coordinator fully read both files. Unchanged vi.mock replaces node:http and node:https requests before the tested module loads. Fake EventEmitter request/response objects only; no network, Electron, stores, services, user data or child processes invoked by tested code. Test allocates a 1MiB+1 Buffer for the response cap. No assertions or mocks modified. Minimal Vitest config is not a security sandbox.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Original installed Vitest4.1.11 with Node24.19.0 on macOS. Minimal node config omits original aliases/setup, feature-wall define, GC/webstorage and platform worker settings; these two files do not depend on them. No full-config equivalence/typecheck claim.
Default unit timeout rather than original30s/60s; outer timeout30s. Fresh pinned capsule only; no installs.
testEvidenceBoundary: Two cases: successful JSON response resolves and removes five listeners; oversized response rejects, destroys request/response once and removes those listeners. Neither exercises actual networking, endpoint selection, upload authorization, consent, timeout, crash reporting, UI or candidate behavior.
